questions.question: Which file decides what page component is shown for each URL path on the site, including the fallback for unknown paths?
questions.note: Creates the browser router with every path to page mapping and the catch-all not found route.

questions.question: Where are the rotating promotional messages at the top of the home page, like the donate and merchandise calls to action, configured?
questions.note: Banner.ts holds the message configs, Banner.tsx rotates them every 4 seconds, MainPage passes the configs in.

questions.question: Where are the online giving links and the list of yearly nonprofit tax filing PDFs kept for the donation page?
questions.note: Donation.ts defines the every.org URLs and Form 990 filing list; Donate.tsx renders them with a show more toggle.

questions.question: Where is the list of top navigation menu entries defined, including the items grouped under About?
questions.note: Header.ts holds the menu data, Header.tsx renders links for desktop and mobile, NavDropdown renders the About submenu.

questions.question: Where are the Matrix chat rooms that visitors are invited to join listed?
questions.note: matrixLinks.ts lists room titles and matrix.to URLs; Matrix.tsx renders them as room cards with setup steps.

questions.question: How does the site load news posts stored as markdown files and parse the metadata block at the top of each file, such as title, date, category and tags?
questions.note: Uses import.meta.glob raw imports, a regex frontmatter parser, defaults for missing fields and sorts posts by date.

questions.question: How does a news post get connected to its writer's profile, and what happens when the writer field is just a plain name instead of a path to a profile file?
questions.note: parseAuthorReference resolves .md paths to author files and falls back to building a slug from the plain name.

questions.question: What extra markdown shortcuts can articles use, such as YouTube embeds, note or warning callout boxes, highlighted text and collapsible sections, and how is the resulting HTML kept safe?
questions.note: Preprocesses custom syntax with regex replacements and renders through react-markdown with a custom sanitize schema.

questions.question: How does the light and dark theme switch remember the visitor's choice across page reloads?
questions.note: Reads and writes a theme key in localStorage and toggles the dark class on the root html element.

questions.question: How does the page that shows people who worked on Sugar Labs code get repository and committer data from GitHub, and how does it load more repositories while scrolling?
questions.note: Calls the GitHub REST API with axios, pages through contributors, and uses an IntersectionObserver for infinite repo loading.

questions.question: What happens when someone opens a link to a single news article: how is the right post found from the URL and turned into rendered content with clickable zoomable images?
questions.note: Detail page reads the slug param, fetches the post by slug from markdown, renders it and wires image click modals.

questions.question: On the Raspberry Pi try-now page, what happens when a visitor clicks one of the operating system cards like Fedora or Debian?
questions.note: Click matches a steps group by heading, sets it as selected, scrolls to it, and the steps carousel renders it from the data file.

questions.question: How do I add a new icon to the set of browser tab icons that the site cycles through?
questions.note: Doc explains placing the SVG in public/favicons and adding it to the array in the script that swaps icons every 2 seconds.

questions.question: What commands do I run to start the local development server and to check linting, formatting and the build before opening a pull request?
questions.note: CONTRIBUTING lists the pre-commit checklist commands; dev_guide covers install, dev server port and preview.

questions.question: As a GSoC student writing weekly progress reports for the website, how do I set up my writer profile and which template should each report follow?
questions.note: Describes the author profile file, the weekly post frontmatter template, and the branch and PR naming workflow.
